svg.aria-label: Every target placed by date and coloured by outcome

a.aria-label: River Witham sword, gold-wire inscription +NDXOXCHWDNCHDXORVI+ (letters 10-11 re-read by Brice Dudout, 11 Nov 2026; BL 2015 ...WDRGH...; British Museum 1858,1116.5; found near Lincoln 1825) (c. 1250-1330): not solved
Alphen aan den Rijn sword, silver-inlaid letters on both faces (found 2002; Provincial Depot Bodemvondsten Zuid-Holland no. 8888) (12th-early 13th c.): not solved

River Witham sword, gold-wire inscription +NDXOXCHWDNCHDXORVI+ (letters 10-11 re-read by Brice Dudout, 11 Nov 2026; BL 2015 ...WDRGH...; British Museum 1858,1116.5; found near Lincoln 1825) (c. 1250-1330): not solved
Fr. Pedro de Vico → Guillem Carbonell, canon of Barcelona, Avignon; Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Climent's papers (Puig 1920 app. XIX, p. 461 n. 3) (4 Dec 1398): not solved

Benedict XIII → Francesc Climent, Avignon → Barcelona, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Climent's papers (Puig's "Documentos inéditos del obispo Çapera", nos. 1063, 409, 1068, 463, 461 …; Meister 1906's capsa "Documentos referentes a la familia Luna I"; catalogue 334, the top pre-1425 lead) (1399–1403): existing decipherment

Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408) (c.1404–38): not solved
Alfonso de Exea, archbishop of Seville → Francesc Climent, Perpignan, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Climent's papers doc. 133 (Puig 1920 app. LXIV; catalogue 334) (23 Aug 1408): existing decipherment

The bishop(?) of Fermo → Sforza Attendolo, Naples, a royal marriage offer, ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 12 (DECODE R4790, catalogued "1500–1599"; second photograph R1858 p. 7; split from catalogue 336) (10 Mar 1413): ciphertext-only break

Letter to the King of Aragon, Barcelona, 2 May [1413–16], ACA Reserva 12 (DECODE R10170, "ca. 1420, non-decrypted, cipher type unknown"; the oldest public image on DECODE) (1413–16): existing decipherment
Pedro Comuel → Francesc Climent, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Climent's papers (Puig 1920 app. CXVI, printed CXVII; catalogue 334) (21 Dec 1415): existing decipherment
Pedro Comuel → Francesc Climent, Arxiu Capitular de Barcelona, Climent's papers (Puig 1920 app. CXXXV; catalogue 334) (27 Jun 1416): existing decipherment

Galeotto Fibindacci da Ricasoli → the Signoria of Florence, Urbino, early 1425 (1424 Florentine style), ASF Dieci di Balìa, Responsive 2 no. 171 (DECODE R3754, "non-decrypted"; oldest-cipher search) (1425): known key applied
Alchymey teuczsch, Heidelberg Cod. Pal. germ. 597, set C, boxes, stars and T (f. 1r ll. 1–2, ff. 5v–6r, 44v, 93r) (DECODE R2876; oldest-cipher candidate A4) (1426): key from external plaintext

Alchymey teuczsch, alchemical recipe book of a circle near Passau, East Bavaria, 1426, Heidelberg Cod. Pal. germ. 597, key A, the compiler's 24-sign "new abc" (f. 1r; recipe names ff. 7r–22r, 46r–v, 54r–61r) (DECODE R2876, "non-decrypted"; oldest-cipher candidate A4) (1426): existing decipherment
Alchymey teuczsch, Heidelberg Cod. Pal. germ. 597, key B, stroke and figure signs (f. 6v invocation; f. 91v in abc order) (DECODE R2876) (1426): existing decipherment

Unnamed Gonzaga agent (Rome) → Gianfrancesco Gonzaga, lord of Mantua, Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Archivio Gonzaga (DECODE R1854 image 2; the record, catalogued as one letter from an unknown sender, holds four letters in four ciphers; catalogue 152, class B) (9 Aug 1428): ciphertext-only break
"Ricc. de Mutiliana" (Forlì) → Gianfrancesco Gonzaga, Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Archivio Gonzaga (DECODE R1854 image 3; catalogue 152, class B) (6 Nov 1428): key from adjacent plaintext

Pandolfo Malatesta, archbishop of Patras (Rome) → Gianfrancesco Gonzaga, Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Archivio Gonzaga (DECODE R1854 image 1; catalogue 152, class B) (22 Apr 1428): external key matched
Sienese envoys → the Priori and Capitano del Popolo of Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 14 (DECODE R4802; from catalogue 336, class B) (before 1429): ciphertext-only break

Francesco de' Cattanei (Rome) → Gianfrancesco Gonzaga, two letters, Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Archivio Gonzaga (DECODE R1854 images 4-5; catalogue 152, class B) (13 and 21 Feb 1430): ciphertext-only break

Cristofano → the Signori of Siena, two letters on the war over Lucca, Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 nos. 6 and 24 (DECODE R4795, R4812, both catalogued "1500–1599"; key R4755 in fasc. 1; split from catalogue 336) (c. 1431–1438 (no. 6: 19 February)): ciphertext-only break

A Sienese informant → the government of Siena, the Milan–Ferrara league slip and the offer of Bianca Maria Visconti to Leonello d'Este, ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 8 (DECODE R4797, catalogued "1500–1599"; from catalogue 336) (c. 1440–41 (proposed)): existing decipherment

Unknown writer → "V. S.", slip with two cipher passages and its decipherment below in a second hand, ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 9 (DECODE R4798, catalogued "1500–1599"; from catalogue 336) (1440s–1450s?): key from adjacent plaintext

Sienese envoys → the government of Siena, kept waiting by the "S. Capitano", ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 19 (DECODE R4807, catalogued "1500–1599"; from catalogue 336) (9 Mar, 1440s (decade from George Lasry)): not solved

Filippo Maria Visconti, Duke of Milan → Francesco Sforza, the cipher slips of his last winter, Milan, Abbiategrasso and Cusago, BnF italien 1583 ff. 110–158 (DECODE R7902, R7904, R7907, R7914, R7915) and italien 1584 ff. 5–102 (Gallica); Oct 2026 Venice/Milan sweep leads 1307 and 1312 (1 Nov 1446 – 23 Mar 1447): external key matched

Contucio, Sforza's envoy at Venice → Francesco Sforza, BnF italien 1583 f. 148 (DECODE R7911; catalogue 1309, class B, which also named ff. 151–152, R7912–R7913: no cipher on either) (7 Dec 1446): known key applied

Filippo Maria Visconti, Duke of Milan → Francesco Sforza, the slip in his second key, Cusago, BnF italien 1584 f. 15 (Gallica canvas 17; Oct 2026 Venice/Milan sweep lead 1312; split 29 Oct 2026 from visconti1446, one key per entry) (23 Jan 1447): external key matched

Marcolino Barbavara (Rimini, Rome) and Pietro Pusterla (Gualdo, Ferrara, Milan) → Francesco Sforza, 16 cipher letters of 21 Jan–4 May 1447, BnF italien 1584 ff. 13–143, key DECODE R1857 (leads 1313, 1314, A) (Jan–May 1447): existing decipherment
Andrea da Birago (Pavia) → Francesco Sforza, 28 Feb 1448, BnF italien 1585 f. 33, key DECODE R5316 (lead 1546) (28 Feb 1448): existing decipherment

Unknown → a correspondent "come padre", informal letter "Karissimo come padre", ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 21 (DECODE R4809, catalogued "1500–1599"; from catalogue 336) (a day of August(?), 15th century): not solved
Nicodemo Tranchedini to Francesco Sforza, 28 June 1452 (Italien 2242 — Tranchedini, 1452) (28 June 1452): existing decipherment

Galgano Borghesi (Naples) → Leonardo Benvoglienti, Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 4 (DECODE R4793, dated "1500–1599" there; from catalogue 336, class B) (12 May 1456): key from adjacent plaintext
